results.content:
Based on 11 reviews

Review Tanka?

Reviewers see Tanka as a useful team assistant that saves time by remembering past conversations, reducing repeated explanations, and making smart replies feel more natural than generic AI. Users especially like using it across busy channels and, in one concrete case, for handling email, WhatsApp, and calendar workflows with a production team. The main caveats are around execution: memory and to-do suggestions still need refinement, integrations could go deeper, and mobile use appears rougher, with one iPhone user reporting a lost conversation.
